personal_info.name: Datri Saranya Saladi
personal_info.title: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering (AI/ML)

description: Worked on data preprocessing, feature extraction, and exploratory data analysis for machine learning experiments.
Built a data preprocessing and feature extraction pipeline to prepare vehicle image datasets for number plate detection models.
Presently working on an ML-based computer vision system that takes a video or live camera feed as input to automatically detect vehicle number plates and extract the license number as text.

projects.title: OMR Based Evaluation System
description: Designed a web-based OMR evaluation system to digitally evaluate objective-type answer sheets when dedicated OMR machines are unavailable.
Planned role-based interfaces for Admin, Faculty (Evaluator), and Students, enabling secure upload of OMR sheets, answer key management, and result viewing.
Defined a modular evaluation workflow including OMR input handling, response processing, rule-based scoring, and result generation.
Focused on a software-centric, cost-effective alternative to hardware-dependent OMR solutions using digitized inputs.
